verdict.rationale: The product's core operation is natural-language driven. Agent API requests take a plain-language `input` plus `instructions`, and the model decides on its own when to call web search, URL fetch or the code sandbox (docs-29, docs-30, docs-5). The official remote MCP server and Computer MCP let users drive Perplexity, including delegated multi-step work, through plain-language requests inside AI assistants (docs-18, docs-4, docs-55). Missing for 10: any natural-language control of administrative/configuration tasks (keys, profiles, usage tiers), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the NL-driven workflows.
